# NumanX Tools Hub (https://toolshub.numanxstudio.com)
> NumanX Tools Hub is a free ($0/month, no sign-up, zero watermarks) suite of 70 client-side web utilities engineered by Muhammad Numan Usmani at NumanX Studio (numanxstudio@gmail.com). Tool workflows process user files and inputs locally in the browser using client-side technologies (including HTML5 Canvas, Web Workers, WebAssembly, and Web Crypto) without uploading files to a server.

## Flagship Creator & Barcode Tools
- [rMQR & QR Code Generator](https://toolshub.numanxstudio.com/tools/qr-generator/): Generate ISO/IEC 23941 Rectangular Micro QR (rMQR) strips (R7x43 to R17x139) and custom square QR codes with WiFi, vCard, Logo, PNG, and vector SVG export.
- [Hashtag Generator](https://toolshub.numanxstudio.com/tools/hashtag-generator/): Generate TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram hashtags with category filters and export options.
- [Markdown Editor](https://toolshub.numanxstudio.com/tools/markdown-editor/): Real-time split-pane GitHub Flavored Markdown editor with HTML and .md file export.

## Flagship Image Optimization Suite (Client-Side Canvas Processing)
- [Image Compressor](https://toolshub.numanxstudio.com/tools/image-compressor/): Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images using adjustable visual-quality settings directly in the browser.
- [JPG to PNG Converter](https://toolshub.numanxstudio.com/tools/jpg-to-png/): Browser-based JPG to PNG image format converter with client-side canvas processing.
- [PNG to WebP Converter](https://toolshub.numanxstudio.com/tools/png-to-webp/): Convert PNG images to WebP format directly in the browser with adjustable quality settings.
- [Image Resizer](https://toolshub.numanxstudio.com/tools/image-resizer/): Dimension presets for YouTube Thumbnails (1280x720), YouTube Banners, TikTok/Shorts (1080x1920), and Instagram.

## Flagship Text, Utility & Cricket Analytics Tools
- [Word Counter](https://toolshub.numanxstudio.com/tools/word-counter/): Real-time word count, character count, per-paragraph breakdown, readability analysis, and keyword density statistics.
- [Age Calculator](https://toolshub.numanxstudio.com/tools/age-calculator/): Calculate chronological age in years, months, days, hours, and next birthday countdown.
- [Password Generator](https://toolshub.numanxstudio.com/tools/password-generator/): Generate passwords using the browser's cryptographic random API, with additional memorable passphrase options and strength evaluation.
- [Cricket Net Run Rate (NRR) & Run Rate Calculators](https://toolshub.numanxstudio.com/category/cricket-tools/): Tournament NRR calculation following ICC Clause 16.10.2 full-quota rules, cricket over arithmetic (balls/6), and playoff qualification scenarios.
